name: Universal FDA Approval Scoring Rubric
note: Canonical on-disk rubric. Max 100 pts across 5 sections, minus risk deductions. See probability_bands for score->approval-probability mapping.

criteria.desc: Primary endpoint met with statistical significance (p<0.05). Partial for trend/p<0.10.
Clinically meaningful effect size, not just statistical (e.g. OS/PFS magnitude, responder rate).
Randomized, double-blind, placebo/active-controlled, adequately powered Phase 3. Deduct for single-arm, open-label, underpowered.
Two adequate & well-controlled trials, or one + confirmatory evidence (FDA's usual bar).
Acceptable safety; no dose-limiting or black-box-tier signals relative to indication severity.
Breakthrough / Fast Track / RMAT / Orphan / Priority Review granted.
SPA agreement in place, or documented End-of-Phase-2 alignment on endpoints.
Positive AdCom vote, or FDA declined to convene one (often a good sign). Negative vote = large deduction.
No prior CRL for this indication; FDA feedback consistent, no shifting goalposts.
Filing accepted, PDUFA date set, no Refuse-to-File or major review-clock extensions.
Manufacturing site passed FDA pre-approval inspection (no OAI/483 open items).
Stability, potency, and comparability data complete; process validated at commercial scale.
Second-source / capacity in place; no single-point API dependency flagged.
No prior CMC-driven CRL or manufacturing consent decree.
Insider buying / no unusual pre-PDUFA selling; aligned incentives.
Funded through decision + launch; not raising desperately at a discount right before PDUFA.
Team has prior approvals; consistent, non-promotional communication; no hype/pump pattern.
Big-pharma partner or commercialization deal signals external DD passed.
Key opinion leaders / treating physicians publicly supportive; unmet need acknowledged.
Pivotal data published in a reputable peer-reviewed journal, not just press release / poster.
Sell-side / specialist consensus leans approval; not a pure retail-driven thesis.
Mechanism/indication has approved precedent, or clear regulatory pathway exists.

risk_deductions.desc: Complete Response Letter previously issued for this indication.
Active or recent FDA clinical hold.
Treatment-related deaths / unresolved serious safety signal.
Data-integrity findings, credible fraud allegations, or SEC action.
Only one underpowered pivotal trial where two are expected.
